Researchers and public health officials are mapping exact vulnerability clusters to direct vital weatherization resources.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing WHAT (building climate resilience) with WHO (blaming individual choices instead of substandard mobile home infrastructure).

Social Physics Analysis:
Systemic actors run a Smart Selfish Maneuver by externalizing climate adaptation costs onto low-income residents, using administrative neglect as a pretext while avoiding structural upgrades.

The Unavoidable Truth: Manufactured housing acts as a lethal thermal trap during extreme heat waves.

The Unavoidable Lie: Official weather fatality statistics accurately reflect the true human toll of extreme heat.
